findings.body: Raise: Not done. This call builds a story's runway only from `current["children"]` and read rounds. `board.py:526` has already excluded parts merged more than seven days ago, so an ongoing story with an older merged part loses that part's recorded working and waiting time. Separately, `time_records.py:481` starts the runway at the first retained part interval or read; a story created before its first cold read loses that earlier unknown time. Both are normal multi-day stories, and the named tests use recent parts and reads. Item 5 requires the story's time split to count its parts and unknown spans.
findings.title: Not done: story runway counts its full elapsed history
